name: Kareo (Tebra) Practice Management API
description: REST API for Kareo (now Tebra) practice management platform. Provides access to patients, appointments, encounters, charges, payments, providers, practices, documents, service locations, procedure codes, and transactions for healthcare practice management and billing.
